allergen.definition: A substance in food that can cause a serious allergic reaction in some people. There are fourteen that have to be declared.
allergen.example: The allergen box says it contains peanuts and soya.

dpn_framing.definition: The choice of words around a fact, which changes how the fact feels.
dpn_framing.example: The framing changed nothing: 400 a month is the same money as 4,800 a year.

evaporation.definition: When liquid water warms up, turns into vapour, and rises into the air.
evaporation.example: Evaporation dried the wet clothes on the line.

intent.definition: A statement of what the user wants to achieve, as opposed to the commands that achieve it.

war_friction.definition: The small resistance between wanting something and getting it, which slows consumption and quietly trains patience.
war_friction.example: Every plan met friction: the weather, the delay, the wrong order.
